Original/repaired first-forward equality must precede any update; extra diagnostic objective evaluations are counted separately, do not accumulate gradients or mutate initial state. B original trainable depth leaves need present finite gradients; a finite zero gradient is valid.
Full initial raw parameters/buffers are persisted; B initial state mismatch stops before its optimization. Same seed alone is insufficient.
Each arm must actually complete all 400 original steps and end-of-run math, world reconstruction and clean checks at unchanged tolerances. Snapshot labels distinguish before/after step.
Both independent producer receipts and sealed input/output/source identities are validated before any sensor-GT bytes, then score every fixed common4 frame with original denominator and raw scale.
